_comment: cc-P182: the web console's Golem buttons. One file, read by web-console/server.py (what the page shows, the word it asks for, the inputs it passes) and by Get-WebActionPlan in scripts/Shard-Console.ps1 (the console action each one runs, and the word checked again before Invoke-Plan). action is a Shard Console action key (Get-ActionPlan); word is what must be typed (case ignored, phones capitalize): a fixed word, '#prompt' (the prompt picked, P<nn>) or '#stopped' (the STOPPED prompt, as the console's plan names it). when: the Golem must be in that state now (winding:<w>, notWinding:<w>, nightShift:on|off, runNext:set). disabled: shown greyed with that reason, refused by the server. art: the button's slot in scripts/console-art (a drawn stand-in until it lands). ASCII only.

actions.label: Wake
actions.help: Opens a new Claude Code session on the game PC on the picked model; it says the start phrase and the Golem hands it the next prompt.

actions.label: Turn on
actions.help: Turns the Golem on (ENABLED). Wake needs it on.

actions.label: Poke
actions.help: Runs the Golem's 10-minute watch now: it looks again at a stall, a rest whose time has come, a pending wake.

actions.label: Rest
actions.help: Rests the Golem now: nothing more is handed on; a running prompt finishes but is not committed.

actions.label: Wrap up after this task
actions.help: The running prompt goes to DONE, is committed and pushed, then the Golem rests (ENABLED kept).

actions.label: Cancel wrap up
actions.help: The queue goes on after the running prompt.

actions.label: Find a stopping point
actions.help: CC finishes its step, leaves both repos green, writes a continuation prompt and ends PAUSED; then the Golem commits and rests.

actions.label: Cancel stopping point
actions.help: Undone if CC has not been told yet; once told, it still ends PAUSED.

actions.label: Long run
actions.help: Up to the cap (a number, or all) until the end time, then back to maxPerRun by itself.

actions.label: End long run
actions.help: maxPerRun counts again from the next hand-off.

actions.label: Night shift on
actions.help: A scheduled task wakes the Golem for a long run between the two times, when the queue, the state and the usage allow.

actions.label: Night shift off
actions.help: The scheduled task Golem Night Shift is removed.

actions.label: Run next
actions.help: The picked queued prompt goes first at the next hand-off. Nothing is renamed.

actions.label: Clear Run next
actions.help: The queue goes in its own order again.

actions.label: Retry stopped prompt
actions.help: The STOPPED prompt goes back into the queue, first, and a session is woken on its own model.

actions.label: Away mode on
actions.disabled: Away mode arrives with P149 (queued, not built yet): there is nothing to switch on.
actions.help: Email controls while Chase is away (P149).

actions.label: Away mode off
actions.disabled: Away mode arrives with P149 (queued, not built yet): there is nothing to switch off.
actions.help: Email controls while Chase is away (P149).
